newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Chase and Citi lend $500 mln for Questor's LBO.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Chase and Citi lend $500 mln for Questor's LBO.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 26 (LPC) - Questor Partners has tapped Chase Manhattan Corp and Citicorp's Citibank for a $500 million bank loan to fund a leveraged buyout, bankers said.
Questor plans to use the funds for its $575 million purchase of the consumer truck rental division of Ryder System Inc, banking sources said.
The loan is split between a $100 million, five-year revolver and a $400 million, five-year term loan, sources added.
Questor will kick in most of the equity in the transaction, bankers said.
Other equity participants in Questor's bid include Madison Dearborn Capital Partners, Societe Generale, Chase Capital Partners and Citicorp North America, according to sources.
